capability: Improve a design one checked round at a time
title: Finished is when every gate opens.

hook.picture: Close on the whale admiring an infographic line, nodding, and pushing it toward a pod.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: It looks finished to me. Can we ship it?
problem_in_viewer_words.who: studio lead at the Friday review

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: three Friday reviews. Each time the whale glances, nods and ships, and each time a pod answers ✕ (every 2 beats, then 1, then half).
why_it_keeps_happening.words: A glance finds what it expects to find.

stakes.body: Clients find the problems first, and every fix after delivery costs trust.

solution_hint: Let a machine check it. Fix. Repeat.

metaphor.body: A row of small gates along the line. The line runs through all of them each round. Flags show what failed, and the counter climbs until every gate glows.

steps.picture: A row of small gates rises along the line. The line runs through. Most glow, and three close with raw sienna flags.
The whale fixes one flagged spot and the line runs again. That gate glows and the counter climbs.
steps.words: Fix what failed. Run every check again.

steps.picture: Push-in: a fix knocks an earlier gate shut again. The flag pops back up, and the rerun catches it at once.
steps.words: A fix that breaks something gets caught.
steps.sound: The muffled stop returns, then a clean click.

steps.picture: The last flags clear. Every gate glows in a row.

real_case.claim: Glyph Foundry's self-improvement loop passed 22 of 52 gates in R0, 37 in R1, 47 in R2 and 52 of 52 in R3 (42.3% to 100.0%, author-reported).

honest_limit.picture: The whale writes the last gate around the line's own shape, so the line passes it. Self-written checks can be cut to fit.
honest_limit.words: We wrote the checks we passed.

not_this.body: Passing our own checks is not praise.

ending_pattern.body: The FELT nod-and-ship moment is replaced by a run through the gate row. One flag is fixed, then the pod answers ✓.
ending_pattern.callback: Same close shot of the nod in bar 1, now interrupted by the gate row before the pod sees it.

end_belief.body: Don't trust the glance. Run the checks.

The pod opens it. A label spills off the frame and an arrow points to nothing. The pod answers with a raw sienna ✕ chip.
beats.words: The client found the problems first.
beats.sound: The figure's second note lands flat.

beats.picture: The whale nudges the label back by eye. Another one spills.
The whale looks from the line to the pod's ✕. Hold.
beats.camera: Close z 1.7, hold on the whale's face

beats.picture: Half a bar of stillness, then the title.
beats.words: Finished is when every gate opens.
beats.camera: Still z 1.6, half bar of stillness

beats.picture: Pull back: a calendar of Friday reviews, glance, nod, ship, ✕.
beats.words: A glance finds what it expects to find.
beats.sound: Problem motif: a muffled click that cuts off early.

beats.picture: Three more reviews, every 2 beats, then 1, then half. Each glance, each ✕.
Motion stops. Faint gate outlines ghost along the line.
beats.words: Let a machine check it. Fix. Repeat.
beats.sound: One clean wood-block click: the signature.

beats.sound: Muffled stop, then a clean click.

beats.picture: Then the pod opens the line and answers ✓. Counter chip.
The glowing gate row, the whale breathing.

score_self.reason: Strong leader pain, and the real numbers carry the case well. The limit (self-written checks) is honest and unusual. The gate idea may overlap with cluster 07 boards.
